key_insight: HISPO improves reinforcement learning for mathematical reasoning by applying importance-sampling correction at the segment level, bridging the gap between token-level and sequence-level credit assignment.
engineering_relevance: For long-form reasoning models, segment-level policy optimization offers a practical way to better localize reward credit and improve training stability on verifiable math tasks.
method: Builds contiguous rollout segments from entropy signals.
Assigns soft saliency weights using segment entropy.
Applies clipped importance-sampling correction at segment granularity.
evidence_signal: Fine-tuning Qwen3-1.7B-Base on six math benchmarks, HISPO improved Pass@8 on all benchmarks and matched or exceeded the strongest baseline in Acc@8 on five.
watch_item: Segment construction depends on entropy estimates, so performance may be sensitive to segmentation thresholds and rollout-time implementation details.
paper_title: HISPO: Hierarchical Importance-Sampling Policy Optimization with Entropy-Derived Segments
